aboutParagraphs: I’m Chelsea Anichebe, an Executive Assistant and Administrative Support professional focused on making work more organised, visible and easier to manage.

When I first stepped into remote work, I started with curiosity and a willingness to learn. Since then, I’ve built projects, worked with different productivity and collaboration tools, and developed a strong understanding of how organization and good systems can make everyday work more efficient.

I’m especially interested in supporting founders, executives and growing teams that value initiative, attention to detail and calm, structured execution. Whether it’s coordinating tasks, keeping information organized, managing schedules, or supporting day-to-day operations, I’m intentional about staying ahead of details and making sure nothing gets overlooked.

For me, it’s not just about getting things done, I'm not just looking to "help out" but become the person a founder stops thinking about because everything just works. My goal is to save time, improve productivity, reduce unnecessary stress, and provide reliable support that allows the people I work with to focus on the work that matters most.
